FAQ

Questions Cape Town parents ask us

How are tutors selected?+
Fewer than 1 in 8 applicants make it. Every tutor must be a current student or graduate of a leading university with at least 70% in the subjects they teach, then pass a written subject test, a live teaching demonstration, an interview and a background check before any home placement.
Do you offer tutoring at my home in Cape Town?+
Yes — in-person home tutoring is available across the Southern Suburbs (Claremont, Rondebosch, Newlands, Constantia and surrounds), the Atlantic Seaboard (Sea Point, Camps Bay), the City Bowl, the Northern Suburbs (Durbanville, Bellville) and the Helderberg (Somerset West). Online lessons cover everywhere else in South Africa and Zambia.
Should we choose online or in-person lessons?+
Both use the same tutors and lesson structure. Online lessons use an interactive whiteboard and are recorded on request — great for consistency and the widest tutor choice. In-person lessons suit younger learners who focus better face-to-face. Many families mix both.
What is your cancellation policy?+
Reschedule or cancel any lesson free of charge with 24 hours’ notice — just message your tutor or our WhatsApp line. Lessons cancelled with less notice are billed, since your tutor has reserved that time.
Can we try a lesson before committing?+
Yes — every new student starts with a trial lesson. If the fit isn’t right, we’ll rematch you with a different tutor at no cost. About 92% of families continue after the trial.
How quickly can we start?+
Most families are matched within 24 hours of sending an enquiry and have their first lesson within the week. During exam season we recommend booking a few days ahead.
